description: This file defines the implementation of the IDataSource interface in Android's media framework, including proxy and binder transaction handling for data source operations.

classes.name: BpDataSource
classes.description: Proxy class for the IDataSource interface, facilitating IPC calls to the actual data source implementation.

classes.name: BnDataSource
classes.description: Binder class handling incoming IPC transactions for IDataSource, implementing the server-side logic.

methods.name: getIMemory
methods.description: Retrieves an IMemory object associated with the data source.

methods.name: readAt
methods.description: Reads data at a specified offset and size from the data source.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Gets the total size of the data source.

methods.name: getFlags
methods.description: Retrieves flags associated with the data source.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the data source.
